subject: Welcome + Gap Analysis for Procurement Setup — next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@procureco.com>, vendor-portal@procureco.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome + Gap Analysis for Procurement Setup — next steps

Hi Olivia and ProcureCo team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get procurement and vendor setup started so we can route POs and invoices cleanly. Attached is a short "what we need from you" worksheet (redwood-vendor-requirements.xlsx) to speed the intake. Quick summary below so we can align on a kickoff: 

What we need from you (please upload to the portal or reply with attachments):
- Completed W-9 or equivalent tax form (ProcureCo legal entity)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured
- Preferred remittance details (bank transfer or AP email) + invoice sample
- Primary vendor contact for billing + technical integration
- Any applicable purchase order (PO) terms or non-standard contract clauses

What Redwood will provide to you:
- Redwood vendor profile creation (we'll provision the vendor ID and notify you)
- PO routing instructions / accounts-payable contact (Karthik will own PO flow)
- A one-page summary of Redwood payment terms and required invoice fields

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute kickoff next week? I have Tue/Wed 10–11am PT open.
- If you prefer, upload the documents to: https://procureco.vendorportal.com/onboard?token=abc123

I'll coordinate internally for PO and billing handoff. If anything on the worksheet is unclear, flag it and we'll walk through on the call.

Thanks — look forward to getting this wrapped up quickly.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnership Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-vendor-requirements.xlsx

Hi all — thanks for the materials and confirming the call earlier today. Quick summary and timeline from PO side: 

- We've created a draft PO workflow and linked the required invoice fields to our AP system. I'll circulate the draft PO and a sample PO number template by EOD Wed (26 Aug).
- Payment terms: standard Redwood net-45. If ProcureCo requires net-30 we can escalate to finance; please flag during the call.
- Next action for ProcureCo: confirm Portal user (email) and preferred remit method (ACH vs wire). Once we have the vendor portal upload and W-9/COI in place we'll provision vendor ID and issue the first PO.

Attached: Redwood_procurement-terms.pdf (terms summary for vendor).
